title: Practice 7: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Он быстро ___ (подползти / подползать) к дереву.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Юрий Тынянов, «Кюхля».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: И ___ (относить / отнести — to take) это к неумению о.
exercises.why: Other: With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. — от + gen.. Подвозить — подвезти — to bring up to (by vehicle), to haul up to, to give a lift; относить — отнести — to take to (on foot); отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to; отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to. Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Леонид Андреев, «Жизнь Василия Фивейского».
exercises.context: Other: With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. — от + gen..

exercises.q: К ним сразу ___ (подойти / подходить) несколько человек.
exercises.why: Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу. Рядовой подходит к сержанту. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  From Александр Грин, «Золотая цепь».
exercises.context: Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу.

exercises.q: И ___ (поднести / подносить — to bring, to carry) к нему.
exercises.why: **поднести́** — **подноси́ть** — to bring, to carry (to); to offer, to present. **подвести́** — **подводи́ть** — to lead (to) .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with к (k, + dative) ‘someone or something’]; to bring closer. **подвезти́** — **подвози́ть** — to bring; to give a lift (in a vehicle). **отойти́** — **отходи́ть** — to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside; (military) to withdraw, to fall back. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  From Иван Шмелёв, «Человек из ресторана».
exercises.context: поднести́** — **подноси́ть — to bring, to carry (to); to offer, to present.

exercises.q: Вот сейчас к отцу ___ (отвести / отводить — to lead away).
exercises.why: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion (the so-called "going verbs"). a) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting a person, indicates going to see that person at his place: Я иду к полковнику. (I am going to the Colonel; to the Colonel's — his office, home, place). b) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting an object or a place, indicates motion toward that object or place: Студент идёт к доске. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  From Фёдор Сологуб, «Мелкий бес».
exercises.context: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion (the so-called "going verbs"). a) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting a person,…
